entities.label: Idea
entities.summary: The death of Israa Ghrayeb took place on 22 August 2019 in the Palestinian city of Bethlehem. Israa Ghrayeb, a 21-year-old Muslim make-up artist, was beaten to death in an "honor killing" because she posted a selfie with her fiancé a day before they were supposed to get engaged. Her family has denied the accusation, saying that instead she died of a heart attack.
